messages.subject: [Riskassessment-news] Version 0.1.13 of mc2d available on CRAN
messages.subject_clean: [Riskassessment-news] Version 0.1.13 of mc2d available on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Starting today, a new version of mc2d (Version 0.1.13) will be deployed on the CRAN mirrors.
?
Version 0.1-13
=============

BUG FIX

- pert, betagen and triang functions were slow in previous versions. This is fixed (thanks to?Matthew Wiener).?
- some of the rdist functions returned matrixes when some of the arguments were matrixes:?to be consistent with distributions functions of the stats package, all parameters but the first one are now vectorized in the univariate p, d, q, r distribution functions

The new version is compliant with the more strict requirements of R 2.15.0. Notably, the data files are now compulsory zipped. As a consequence?(!) mc2d now?requires R >=2.10.0 version. 
?
Best.
R.
